title: Please help my family through the next few months
story: This year has been the hardest our family has known and I would not be writing this if there were any other way. We are behind on everything and the pressure on my parents is something I cannot describe. Whatever you can give will go towards getting us through the next few months and back on our feet. Please keep us in your prayers even if you cannot give.
reviewerNote: Information requested, and I want it on the record that this is not a refusal. The copy states hardship four times and states nothing a reviewer can weigh: no income, no outgoings, no assets, no named debt, no specific cost. Two or three categories are plausibly in play and not one of them can be assessed on this text. I asked for the household's monthly income and outgoings, whether there are savings or property, and what specific bill the money would clear first, and I said in the message that a short factual paragraph is worth more here than the appeal is. Held open pending the answer.
